Monk Canthan armor is an art type available in the Factions campaign both as crafted armor and as collector armor for the region of Kaineng City.

The prestige version of this armor is Monk Elite Canthan armor.

sets.name: 僧侣 · Censor
sets.notes:
Monk Censor armor is an art type available in the Prophecies campaign. It is known as PvP Militant armor for PvP characters.

The prestige version of this armor is Monk Elite Judge armor.

sets.name: 僧侣 · Dragon
sets.notes:
Monk Dragon armor is an art type introduced in the Prophecies campaign and the scalp design from this set is also available as a collector reward in Prophecies and from armorers in the Factions campaign and Eye of the North expansion. In Prophecies only headgear with an armor rating higher than 15 has an attribute bonus.

There is another variant of this armor art named Monk Star armor.

The prestige versions of this armor are Monk Flowing armor and Monk Labyrinthine armor.

sets.name: 僧侣 · 精英凯珊
sets.notes:
Monk Elite Canthan armor is a prestige art type available in the Factions campaign.

This armor is only available in the Divine Path, an explorable area only accessible by completing Imperial Sanctum. If you plan on buying this armor make sure you take all of the required crafting materials and money into the mission with you, as there are no Xunlai Agents, material traders, or rare material traders available in the zone.

The standard version of this armor is Monk Canthan armor.

sets.name: 僧侣 · Elite Judge
sets.notes:
Monk Elite Judge armor is a prestige art type available in the Prophecies campaign.

The standard version of this armor is Monk Censor armor.



* This armor is labeled Granite Citadel Ascended Armor in the "Resilience" monument in the Hall of Monuments.

Monk Elite Kurzick armor is a prestige armor art type available in the Factions campaign.

The standard version of this armor is Monk Kurzick armor.

sets.name: 僧侣 · 精英勒克森
sets.notes:
Monk Elite Luxon armor is a prestige art type available in the Factions campaign.

The standard version of this armor is Monk Luxon armor.



Guild capes, if displayed, have a clipping issue with the pants. The tip of the cape clips through and "flaps" while in the bugged clipping

sets.name: 僧侣 · Elite Saintly
sets.notes:
Monk Elite Saintly armor is a prestige art type available in the Prophecies campaign.

This armor is a reskin of the Monk Krytan armor, but the standard version of this armor is actually Monk Sacred armor.



* This armor is labeled Marhan's Grotto Elite Armor in the "Resilience" monument in the Hall of Monuments.
* The bands on the upper arms are linked to the chest piece, not the handwraps.

sets.name: 僧侣 · Elite Woven
sets.notes:
Monk Elite Woven armor is a prestige art type available in the Prophecies campaign.

The standard version of this armor is Monk Woven armor.



* This armor is labeled Granite Citadel Exclusive Armor in the "Resilience" monument in the Hall of Monuments.

sets.name: 僧侣 · Flowing
sets.notes:
Monk Flowing armor is a prestige art type available in the Prophecies campaign.

The standard versions of this armor are Monk Dragon armor and Monk Star armor. 



* This armor is labeled Granite Citadel Elite Armor in the "Resilience" monument in the Hall of Monuments.
* The female armor waist has some animation issues when running.
* There is a variant of this armor called Monk Labyrinthine armor.

sets.name: 僧侣 · Gilded Vestments
sets.notes:
Monk Gilded Vestments is a prestige armor piece available in the Eye of the North expansion. You need to be at least rank 5 (Bold Delver) in the Deldrimor title track to be able to craft this armor.



*Female armor part is a reskin of Monk Elite Woven vestments.
*Male armor part is a reskin of Monk Sacred Vestments.

sets.name: 僧侣 · 伊斯坦
sets.notes:
Monk Istani armor is an art type available in the Nightfall campaign as starter armor, as collector armor for the region of Istan and as regular crafted armor. The collector headgear is only available with a Divine Favor +1 bonus. 

There is no prestige version of Istani armor.

sets.name: 僧侣 · 科瑞塔
sets.notes:
Monk Krytan armor is an art type introduced in the Prophecies campaign as collector armor and is also available in the Factions campaign.

Note: Monk Krytan armor art does not have headgear. The Dragon Scalp Design is used as collector scalp design in Prophecies and it is also available from Oroku in Factions. Pictures, crafting and collecting details are available on that page.

There is no prestige version of Krytan armor (although Elite Saintly armor uses the same model).

This armor set dyes lighter if acquired from Factions.

sets.name: 僧侣 · 库尔兹柯

The prestige version of this armor is Monk Elite Kurzick armor.

sets.name: 僧侣 · Labyrinthine
sets.notes:
Monk Labyrinthine armor is a prestige art type introduced in the Prophecies campaign in the May 24th, 2007 update. 

The standard versions of this armor are Monk Dragon armor and Monk Star armor, and there is also another prestige variant called Monk Flowing armor.



* This armor is labeled Marhan's Grotto Exclusive Armor in the "Resilience" monument in the Hall of Monuments.
* This armor uses the same inventory icons as Monk Dragon armor.
* The necklace can only be seen if your guild cape is turned off.
* The female version's legs will occasionally clip through the skirt when raised high; this is easily seen during the dance animation.

sets.name: 僧侣 · 勒克森

sets.name: 僧侣 · 纪念

* The individual armor components are similar to components from previously released armor sets.

sets.name: 死灵法师 · Ragged Scar Pattern
sets.notes:
Necromancer Ragged Scar Pattern is a face scar pattern art introduced in the Prophecies campaign and is also available in the Factions campaign and Eye of the North expansion. It is also available in Prophecies as part of the Initiate's set (Necromancer starter armor) or traded from collectors. Below maximum armor rating in Prophecies, it is crafted with an optional attribute bonus, all Necromancer attributes except Soul Reaping are available. At maximum armor rating it can be crafted with any of the Necromancer attributes.

Necromancer Devilish Scar Pattern is a name variant available from armorers in the Prophecies campaign. Below maximum armor rating it is crafted with a Soul Reaping attribute bonus. At maximum armor rating it can be crafted with any of the Necromancer attributes.

sets.name: 通用 · Chaos Gloves
sets.notes:
Chaos Gloves are a prestige glove art available in the Eye of the North expansion. You need to be at least rank 5 (Bold Delver) in the Deldrimor title track to be able to craft this armor.




* Similar to all Mesmer gloves, the Mesmer Chaos Gloves only come up to the wrist.
* If you use an Expert Salvage Kit on the gloves, they will salvage into one of the following:
** 30-40 Piles of Glittering Dust, 2-3 Globs of Ectoplasm
** 25-39 Globs of Ectoplasm
** Piles of Glittering Dust.

=== Coloring notes ===
* When dyed certain colors, there is an extension of the glow from the hand for some female characters.
* Part of the glow is generated through post-processing effects, which many people turn off (either because their system performs better or to avoid changes to the screen as a result being drunk).
* Black (and to a lesser extent silver) dye can dim the glow of the gloves by decreasing the distance of the colored aura from the arm (the color of the arm does not change).
When Chaos Gloves are viewed through a semi-transparent surface, such as in water or under an Ooze, they disappear, making your character appear to not have hands.
If a character cycles between their chaos gloves and another pair of gloves at a semi-fast rate, the chaos gloves will appear with an orange shaded-in box around them for a few milliseconds.

Necromancer Primeval armor is a prestige armor art available in the Nightfall campaign.

There is no standard version of Primeval armor. However, Istani armor resembles it.

The Bandana is a prestige headgear art available in the Eye of the North expansion. You need to be at least rank 5 (Bold Delver) in the Deldrimor title track to be able to craft this armor. It has an Item's Attribute +1 bonus.



* Sometimes the ties of the bandana have clipping issues with neck pieces of armor.

There are clipping issues with the Bandana and three different male armors: warrior monument, necromancer asuran, and mesmer norn. In addition, there are stretching errors with the necromancer dance emote.

Chaos Gloves are a prestige glove art available in the Eye of the North expansion. You need to be at least rank 5 (Bold Delver) in the Deldrimor title track to be able to craft this armor.




* Similar to all Mesmer gloves, the Mesmer Chaos Gloves only come up to the wrist.
* If you use an Expert Salvage Kit on the gloves, they will salvage into one of the following:
** 30-40 Piles of Glittering Dust, 2-3 Globs of Ectoplasm
** 25-39 Globs of Ectoplasm
** Piles of Glittering Dust.

=== Coloring notes ===
* When dyed certain colors, there is an extension of the glow from the hand for some female characters.
* Part of the glow is generated through post-processing effects, which many people turn off (either because their system performs better or to avoid changes to the screen as a result being drunk).
* Black (and to a lesser extent silver) dye can dim the glow of the gloves by decreasing the distance of the colored aura from the arm (the color of the arm does not change).
When Chaos Gloves are viewed through a semi-transparent surface, such as in water or under an Ooze, they disappear, making your character appear to not have hands.
If a character cycles between their chaos gloves and another pair of gloves at a semi-fast rate, the chaos gloves will appear with an orange shaded-in box around them for a few milliseconds.

* Similar to all Mesmer gloves, the Mesmer Dragon Gauntlets only come up to the wrist.
* Has clipping issues with most shields.

Highlander Woad is a prestige headgear art available in the Eye of the North expansion. You need to be at least rank 5 (Slayer of Wurms) in the Norn title track to be able to craft this armor. It has an Item's Attribute +1 bonus.




* All characters will have the left side of their face dyed white while wearing this item, depending on your skin tone. Females have the left side of their face whiter.
* Certain character faces have a little strip of the color dye on the un-dyed side of the face.
* Depending upon your character's face, your eyebrows may be hidden while wearing this item.

Norn Woad is a prestige headgear art available in the Eye of the North expansion. You need to be at least rank 5 (Slayer of Wurms) in the Norn title track to be able to craft this armor. It has an Item's Attribute +1 bonus.

Slim Spectacles is a prestige headgear art available in the Eye of the North expansion. You need to be at least rank 5 (Not Too Annoying) in the Asura title track to be able to craft this armor. It has an Item's Attribute +1 bonus.



* Cannot be dyed.
* Clips through some female hairstyles with bangs.

Spectacles is a prestige headgear art available in the Eye of the North expansion. You need to be at least rank 5 (Not Too Annoying) in the Asura title track to be able to craft this armor. It has an Item's Attribute +1 bonus.

* A warrior or ranger's default eyepatch will not be removed while wearing Spectacles.
* Females with bangs may find spectacles "slip through" their bangs.

The Stone Gauntlets are prestige gloves available in the Eye of the North expansion. You need to be at least rank 5 (Bold Delver) in the Deldrimor title track to be able to craft this armor.

armorers.name: Gobrech Stonefoot
armorers.notes:
__NOTOC__
Gobrech Stonefoot is the armorer in Central Transfer Chamber. He crafts cross-profession armor pieces as well as stand alone profession-specific pieces commonly referred to as Deldrimor armor.
*You must be rank 5 (Bold Delver) in the Deldrimor title track in order to use his services.

armorers.name: Mehinu
armorers.notes:
__NOTOC__
Mehinu crafts armor for core and Nightfall professions. All armor is crafted with an empty insignia slot.

armorers.name: Pasu
armorers.notes:
__NOTOC__
Pasu crafts armor for core and Nightfall professions. All armor is crafted with an empty insignia slot.

armorers.name: Sulee
armorers.notes:
__NOTOC__
Sulee crafts armor for core and Nightfall professions.

armorers.name: Vatundo
armorers.notes:
__NOTOC__
Vatundo crafts armor for core and Nightfall professions. Vatundo crafts the same types of armor as Burreh in the Sunspear Command Post.

armorers.name: Burreh
armorers.notes:
__NOTOC__
Burreh crafts armor for core and Nightfall professions. Burreh crafts the same types of armor as Vatundo in the Consulate Docks.

armorers.name: Oroku
armorers.notes:
__NOTOC__
About the crafter; for the Winds of Change NPC, see Oroku (Ministry of Purity).

Oroku crafts armor for core professions using the Krytan armor art and Factions professions using the Imperial armor art. Oroku also crafts Monk, Necromancer and Mesmer Prophecies headgear art as well as Elementalist auras. All armor is crafted with a blank insignia slot.

armorers.name: Morbach
armorers.notes:
__NOTOC__
Morbach crafts armor for core and Factions professions using the Kurzick armor art. Morbach also crafts Elementalist auras.
All armor is crafted with an empty insignia slot.

Kurzick armor requires the rare crafting material Amber Chunk.

armorers.name: Tateos
armorers.notes:
__NOTOC__
Tateos crafts armor for core and Factions professions using the Luxon armor art. Tateos also crafts Elementalist Auras. All armor is crafted with an empty insignia slot.

Luxon armor requires the rare crafting material Jadeite.

armorers.name: Brett
armorers.notes:
__NOTOC__
Brett is an Armorer for the Ebon Vanguard. He only offers his services for players who have attained the rank of Shadow Agent.

armorers.name: Radi
armorers.notes:
__NOTOC__
Radi crafts Norn armor for all professions, as well as Highlander Woad and Norn Woad. He will only craft armor for characters who reach the fifth Norn rank, Slayer of Wurms. All armor is crafted with an empty insignia slot.

armorers.name: Eternal Forgemaster
armorers.notes:
__NOTOC__
The Eternal Forgemaster crafts prestige armor for all professions. All armor is crafted with an empty insignia slot. In order for the Eternal Forgemaster to appear in the Fissure of Woe players must finish the following quest:
*The Eternal Forgemaster
In order for the Eternal Forgemaster to craft armor for players, the following quests must be completed as well:
*Defend the Temple of War
*Restore the Temple of War
*If he dies, your team will be kicked from the Fissure of Woe. He will not be threatened by new spawns after completion of Defend the Temple of War, however nearby mobs could be accidentally lured towards him.
*This NPC has a miniature version.

armorers.name: Morgren
armorers.notes:
__NOTOC__
Morgren crafts armor for each of the core professions. Morgren and Seifred are the first crafters who craft maximum armor rating armor in Prophecies.

armorers.name: Keeper of Armor
armorers.notes:
__NOTOC__
The Keeper of Armor crafts prestige armor for core and Nightfall professions using the Primeval armor art. Each armor piece has an empty slot for adding an insignia. Headgear includes an attribute +1 bonus.

armorers.name: Moon Ahn
armorers.notes:
__NOTOC__
Moon Ahn crafts armor for core and Factions professions using the Shing Jea armor art and also the Elementalist auras art. All armor is crafted with an empty insignia slot.

armorers.name: Seiji
armorers.notes:
About the armorer; for the special event collector, see Seiji (collector).
__NOTOC__
Seiji crafts armor for core and Factions professions using the Shing Jea armor art. Seiji also crafts Elementalist auras. All armor is crafted with an empty insignia slot.

armorers.name: Lain
armorers.notes:
__NOTOC__
Lain crafts armor for core and Factions professions using the Shing Jea armor art. Lain also crafts Elementalist auras. All armor is crafted with an empty insignia slot.

armorers.name: Ryoko
armorers.notes:
__NOTOC__
Ryoko crafts armor for core and Factions professions using the Shing Jea armor art. Ryoko also crafts Elementalist auras.

armorers.name: Ahamid
armorers.notes:
__NOTOC__
Ahamid crafts prestige armor for core and Nightfall professions. Ahamid will only appear in the Command Post after the completion of the quest Building the Base: Prisoners of War.

armorers.name: Voldo the Exotic
armorers.notes:
__NOTOC__
Voldo the Exotic crafts armor for core professions using the Tyrian armor art and Factions professions using the Exotic armor art. Voldo also crafts Ranger, Monk, Necromancer and Mesmer Prophecies headgear art and also Elementalist auras. All armor is crafted with a blank insignia slot.

armorers.name: Jolvor Stoneforge
armorers.notes:
__NOTOC__
Jolvor Stoneforge is an armorsmith in Boreal Station offering basic max armor.
*This NPC was added in the 6th December 2007 update to provide a cheaper source of maxed armor within the Guild Wars Eye of the North expansion.

armorers.name: Mateneh
armorers.notes:
__NOTOC__
Mateneh crafts the prestige Vabbian Armor for core, Factions and Nightfall professions.

armorers.name: Wei Qi
armorers.notes:
__NOTOC__
Wei Qi crafts prestige armor for Factions professions using the ascended Exotic armor art. All armor is crafted with an empty insignia slot. Fellow armorers Koumei and Maiya are found next to Wei Qi.

armorers.name: Maiya
armorers.notes:
__NOTOC__
Maiya crafts prestige armor for Factions professions using the ascended Imperial armor art. All armor is crafted with an empty insignia slot. Fellow armorers Koumei and Wei Qi can be found next to Maiya.
